description: Salesforce is a CRM and sales platform that provides various APIs and authentication frameworks for integrating with external systems.

evidence.claim: Salesforce supports six active OAuth 2.0 flows including JWT Bearer, Client Credentials, Web Server, PKCE, and User-Agent.
OAuth 2.0 requires configuration in the user interface and other locations.
Salesforce provides Named Credentials and External Credentials to manage authentication and endpoints securely.
Users can build and deploy an OAuth-secured MCP server on MuleSoft CloudHub to empower Agentforce agents.

description: HubSpot is a CRM and marketing/sales/service platform that provides a broad REST API and an app marketplace.

evidence.claim: HubSpot provides a remote MCP server at mcp.hubspot.com for interacting with CRM data.
Service Keys are account-level API credentials for system-to-system, data-only integrations.
OAuth is required for apps intended for multiple accounts or the HubSpot Marketplace.
The HubSpot MCP server enables AI assistants to interact with CRM data through natural conversation.

description: Pipedrive is a sales-pipeline-focused CRM designed for small and mid-market sales teams.

evidence.claim: Pipedrive offers a RESTful API that uses JSON format and is validated against an API token.
OAuth 2.0 is required for developing apps available in the Pipedrive Marketplace.
Pipedrive launched a native official MCP server.
The API covers deals, persons, organizations, activities, notes, pipelines, products, leads, files, users, custom fields, and webhooks.

description: A highly customizable CRM platform built around a flexible data model for revenue teams.

evidence.claim: Attio provides a public REST API which exchanges JSON over HTTPS.
Attio implements the standard OAuth 2.0 specification.
You can manually generate an API key in the developer settings page of your apps.
Expose Attio to AI clients using the MCP server.

description: An open-source CRM that is self-hostable or available in the cloud, featuring an auto-generated REST and GraphQL API based on the workspace data model.

evidence.claim: REST and GraphQL APIs are generated from the workspace schema.
API key can be generated instantly from Settings > API & Webhooks.
Supports OAuth 2.0 with authorization code + PKCE and client credentials.
Community MCP servers exist (mhenry3164, igorwarzocha, jezweb).

description: A flexible, app-based work and CRM platform that allows users to manage custom app data, contacts, and tasks.
main_blocker: Low default rate limit (250 req/hr per client_id) constrains agent workloads.

evidence.claim: The Podio API uses the OAuth2 protocol for authentication.
Rate limit is 250 authenticated requests/hour per client_id.
An MCP server exists that gives AI agents access to the Podio API.
ProcFu enhances Podio's capabilities by providing a suite of automation tools.

description: Zoho CRM is a mature CRM platform within the Zoho suite that provides extensive REST, Bulk, and COQL APIs for managing sales and customer data.

evidence.claim: Zoho CRM uses the OAuth 2.0 protocol for authentication.
Zoho CRM provides pre-built MCP servers for Data Insights, Data Operations, Module Customization, and Workflow & Process Automation.
Any Zoho CRM account (including permanent free plan, up to 3 users) has API access with 5,000 API credits/day.
Zoho CRM provides OpenAPI Specification (OAS) files for version 8.0.

description: Inside-sales-focused CRM with built-in calling and email, featuring a REST API designed for scripts and integrations.

evidence.claim: Close uses industry-standard REST conventions with predictable URL structures, standard HTTP methods, and JSON request/response bodies.
Two methods are supported: API Keys and OAuth 2.0.
Close's MCP server is officially supported across the Claude ecosystem.
API keys can be created in Settings -> Developer -> API Keys.

description: Copper is a Google-Workspace-native CRM designed for relationship-driven sales teams.

evidence.claim: Copper offers OAuth2.0 and API Keys for authentication.
API keys can be generated in System settings > API Keys.
The API covers Leads, People, Companies, Opportunities, activities, and custom fields.
No official Composio toolkit exists for Copper.

description: DealCloud is a vertical CRM and deal-management platform designed for private equity, investment banking, and capital markets firms.
main_blocker: Requires being an existing paying DealCloud client with admin-provisioned API access; no self-serve trial/sandbox account discoverable.

evidence.claim: To enable API access, ensure the intended user is assigned to a user group with the appropriate permissions and enable 'API' in Site Areas.
DealCloud MCP Server — client preview starting July 2026
DealCloud MCP uses OAuth to authenticate, letting AI assistants connect on behalf of an individual user.
The Data APIs are used to manipulate records in the site.
